note: Text JSON fixtures of the project's own IVSC v1 container (docs/formats/ivsc-v1.md); every byte is authored for this project and no third-party image or container is copied. No binary container (.ivsc, .rom, .bin) is committed: positives are hex text, negatives are patches of a positive base, and maximum-size containers are assembled in test code from repeated words. Any edit of a listed output reruns sh tools/cart/manifest-outputs.sh and refreshes these outputs in the same commit.
